lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Flying a Kite. It is a bright, sunny day. Peppa and her family are in the park. They are going to fly a kite.
lines.zh: 放风筝。今天阳光明媚。佩奇和家人在公园里。他们要去放风筝。

lines.en: George is going to fly the kite first. George runs as fast as he can, but the kite won't fly.
lines.zh: 乔治先来放风筝。乔治拼命地跑，可风筝就是飞不起来。

lines.en: George, you're doing it all wrong. You didn't run fast enough. Now it's my turn.
lines.zh: 乔治，你做得全不对。你跑得不够快。现在轮到我了。

lines.en: Peppa runs as fast as she can, but the kite still won't fly.
lines.zh: 佩奇也拼命地跑，可风筝还是飞不起来。

lines.en: The kite won't fly if there isn't any wind, no matter how fast you run.
lines.zh: 如果没有风，不管你跑多快，风筝都飞不起来。

lines.en: Oh, we just have to wait until the wind picks up a bit. Look, it's getting windy. Now that it is windy, the kite can fly.
lines.zh: 哦，我们只要等风大一点就行。看，起风了。现在有风了，风筝就能飞了。

lines.en: The wind is quite strong now. The wind is very strong now.
lines.zh: 现在风挺大的。现在风非常大。

lines.en: George. Thank you, Daddy. Daddy Pig flies the kite.
lines.zh: 乔治。谢谢你，爸爸。猪爸爸放起了风筝。

lines.en: Hooray! Higher! Higher!
lines.zh: 太好啦！再高一点！再高一点！

lines.en: Daddy Pig flies the kite very well.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸风筝放得非常好。

lines.en: Wow! Yes, I am a bit of an expert at these things.
lines.zh: 哇！是的，我对这些事情还算在行。

lines.en: Watch out for the trees. You might get the kite stuck in one. Don't worry, I know what I'm doing.
lines.zh: 小心那些树。风筝可能会卡在树上。别担心，我知道我在做什么。

lines.en: Oh, dear. Daddy Pig has got the kite caught in a tree.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。猪爸爸把风筝卡在树上了。

lines.en: Oh, no! Don't worry, George. Daddy will get the kite down.
lines.zh: 哦，不！别担心，乔治。爸爸会把风筝取下来的。

lines.en: Hooray! Uh...
lines.zh: 太好啦！呃……

lines.en: Yes. Careful, there's a big muddy puddle. Peppa and George love to jump in muddy puddles. Can we jump in the puddle, please? No, I don't want you covered in mud.
lines.zh: 好。小心，有一个大泥坑。佩奇和乔治喜欢在泥坑里跳。请问我们能跳进泥坑里吗？不行，我可不想你们弄得一身泥。

lines.en: Ah, stand back, children. Please be careful, Daddy Pig. I know what I'm doing.
lines.zh: 啊，孩子们，退后一点。猪爸爸，请小心。我知道我在做什么。

lines.en: Please be careful. Just a bit further. Daddy!
lines.zh: 请小心一点。再往前一点点。爸爸！

lines.en: Daddy Pig, you are much too heavy for that branch! Nonsense, I know exactly how heavy I am.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸，那根树枝可承受不了你的重量！胡说，我清楚自己有多重。

lines.en: There! Hooray! Daddy Pig has rescued the kite.
lines.zh: 好了！太好啦！猪爸爸把风筝救下来了。

lines.en: Oh, dear. Everyone is covered in mud.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。大家都弄得一身泥。

lines.en: It's only mud. Luckily, Daddy Pig hasn't hurt himself, and the kite is out of the tree.
lines.zh: 只是泥而已。幸好猪爸爸没有受伤，风筝也从树上取下来了。

lines.en: Hooray! Mummy, now that we're all muddy, can we jump in the puddle?
lines.zh: 太好啦！妈妈，既然我们都已经一身泥了，我们能跳泥坑吗？

lines.en: I suppose so. After all, you can't get any muddier. And I think Daddy Pig is going to be doing the washing.
lines.zh: 我想可以吧。反正你们也不会更脏了。而且我觉得猪爸爸得负责洗衣服了。

lines.en: Oh. Peppa and George love jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 哦。佩奇和乔治喜欢在泥坑里跳上跳下。

lines.en: Mummy and Daddy love jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 猪妈妈和猪爸爸也喜欢在泥坑里跳上跳下。

lines.en: Everyone loves jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 大家都喜欢在泥坑里跳上跳下。

lines.en: Jumping up and down in muddy puddles is just as much fun as flying the kite.
lines.zh: 在泥坑里跳上跳下，跟放风筝一样好玩。
